purpose: Linux web and workflow development toolchain, centrally managed independently of application source checkouts.
operatorNotes: Migration seed from mickmister/gh-agentic-workflows commit 91ba76729e00259a6c6d01a6edda15b9c1151aa4. Canonical revisions belong in S3; this file is an executor migration fixture, not the live definition. Pins Nixpkgs and Node 22.22.2 for x86_64 Linux. This environment does not provision Android or Apple tooling. The probe package is retained for historical same-session feasibility tests and is not included in the web shell. Qualification installs semver 7.7.2 with npm into the role's private HOME, verifies persistence between commands, and checks/cleans up a local HTTP service. npm outputs are not Nix-cacheable. Offline Nix profile activation does not make npm network-free. Use {environment} paths in qualification commands; no Nix files need to be added to an application repository. Fork or propose a new immutable revision for durable changes, and record why it differs.
